- **Corpus rows (reasoning-covered)**: 3101 (658 failed, 2443 correct)
- **Scope**: all
- **Word tokenization**: content words (stopwords removed); phrase tokenization keeps function words for loop detection
- **Dirichlet prior** a = 0.01 (symmetric pseudo-count)

## Differential Phrase Nets

<script src="../assets/js/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('phrase-net-status');
  if (typeof vis === 'undefined' || !vis.Network) {
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Network library failed to load — see static SVG below.';
    return;
  }
  var base = (window.location.pathname.match(/.*\//) || ['/'])[0];
  // The vendored vis-network 9.1.9 renders STRING tooltips via `innerText`
  // (HTML shows literally as <b>…</b>); it appends DOM elements with full
  // HTML instead. Build element titles so markup renders, not displays.
  function tooltipHtml(html) {
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.innerHTML = html;
    return el;
  }
  fetch(base + '../charts/phrase_net_differential.json')
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {
      var nodeMap = {};
      data.nodes.forEach(function (n) { nodeMap[n.id] = n; });
      var nodes = data.nodes.map(function (n) {
        var total = n.fail + n.ok;
        var size = 14 + 6 * Math.log1p(Math.max(total, 1));
        var share = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n.share));
        var lo = [0.40, 0.77, 0.66], hi = [0.88, 0.52, 0.50];
        var c = [0, 1, 2].map(function (i) { return lo[i] * (1 - share) + hi[i] * share; });
        var hex = '#' + c.map(function (v) { return Math.round(v * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0'); }).join('');
        return {
          id: n.id, label: n.id, size: size, color: { background: hex, border: '#5b6577' },
          shape: n.leak ? 'diamond' : 'circle',
          title: tooltipHtml(n.id + '<br>failed traces: <b>' + n.fail + '</b> · correct: <b>' + n.ok + '</b>' +
                  '<br>failure share: <b>' + (100 * share).toFixed(1) + '%</b>' +
                  (n.leak ? '<br><i>prompt-leaked vocabulary</i>' : '')),
          font: { color: '#1b2a4a', size: 13, face: 'Source Sans 3' },
          borderWidth: 1.2, borderWidthSelected: 2.5, shadow: { enabled: true, size: 12 }
        };
      });
      var zMax = Math.max.apply(null, data.edges.map(function (e) { return Math.abs(e.z); }));
      var edges = data.edges.map(function (e) {
        var ec, tag;
        if (e.in_cycle) {
          ec = { color: '#c76e63', highlight: '#a8574d', opacity: 1.0 };
          tag = 'structural loop (failed traces)';
        } else if (e.bias === 'ok') {
          ec = { color: '#66c4a8', highlight: '#4fae8f', opacity: 0.6 };
          tag = 'success-biased differential';
        } else {
          ec = { color: '#e08580', highlight: '#c76e63', opacity: 0.6 };
          tag = 'failure-biased differential';
        }
        return {
          from: e.from, to: e.to,
          width: 0.6 + 4.4 * Math.abs(e.z) / zMax,
          color: ec,
          arrows: { to: { enabled: true, scaleFactor: 0.75 } },
          title: tooltipHtml(e.from + ' → ' + e.to + '<br>z = <b>' + e.z.toFixed(2) + '</b>' +
                  '<br>failed: <b>' + e.fail + '</b> · correct: <b>' + e.ok + '</b>' +
                  '<br><i>' + tag + '</i>'),
          smooth: { type: 'continuous', roundness: 0.25 }
        };
      });
      var container = document.getElementById('phrase-net-canvas');
      var opts = {
        physics: { enabled: true, stabilization: { iterations: 300 }, barnesHut: { gravitationalConstant: -32000, springLength: 130, springConstant: 0.035, damping: 0.6 } },
        interaction: { hover: true, tooltipDelay: 120, dragNodes: true, zoomView: true, hoverConnectedEdges: true, hideEdgesOnDrag: true },
        nodes: { scaling: { min: 8, max: 42 } },
        edges: { selectionWidth: 2, hoverWidth: 2 }
      };
      var network = new vis.Network(container, { nodes: nodes, edges: edges }, opts);
      network.once('stabilizationIterationsDone', function () {
        network.setOptions({ physics: false });
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = data.nodes.length + ' words · ' + data.edges.length + ' edges · failure- and success-biased language';
      });
      network.on('stabilizationProgress', function (p) {
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Laying out graph… ' + Math.round(100 * p.iterations / p.total) + '%';
      });
    })
    .catch(function (err) {
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Could not load graph data (' + err.message + ') — see static SVG below.';
    });
})();
</script>


<figcaption>The interactive differential phrase net — drag nodes, zoom, and hover for raw counts and log-odds. A static rendering follows as a print/no-JS fallback.</figcaption>

![Differential phrase net — static rendering](../charts/phrase_net_differential.svg)

Directed bi-gram graph of the reasoning traces, restricted to edges whose prevalence in **failed** traces exceeds their prevalence in **correct** traces (log-odds difference ≥ threshold, ≥ min failed occurrences). The differential filter removes the corporate boilerplate and prompt-leaked tokens shared with correct traces, leaving the phrases characteristic of reasoning breakdowns. Diamond-outlined nodes are **prompt-leaked** tokens — words the model parrots from the prompt text itself. Red edges are structural loops.

## Log-Odds Ratio (Uninformative Dirichlet Prior)

![Log-odds bar chart](../charts/logodds_dirichlet.svg)

Fightin' Words (Monroe, Colaresi & Quinn, 2008): `z = log((y_f + a)/(n_f - y_f + a)) - log((y_o + a)/(n_o - y_o + a))` with the symmetric prior a on every count. Positive *z* = word is more likely to appear in a failed trace; negative *z* = more likely in a correct trace. Words shared across both classes (boilerplate, prompt-leaked labels) sit near *z* = 0 and drop out of the extremes.

<script>
(function () {
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('scatter-status');
  if (typeof d3 === 'undefined') {
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'D3 failed to load — see static SVG below.';
    return;
  }
  var base = (window.location.pathname.match(/.*\//) || ['/'])[0];
  fetch(base + '../charts/scattertext_style.json')
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {
      var widgetEl = document.querySelector('.scatter-widget');
      var canvasEl = document.getElementById('scatter-canvas');
      var tooltipEl = document.getElementById('scatter-tooltip');
      var countEl = document.getElementById('scatter-count');
      var searchEl = document.getElementById('scatter-search');
      var resetEl = document.getElementById('scatter-reset');
      if (!widgetEl || !canvasEl) return;

      var points = data.points.map(function (p) {
        return {
          word: p.word, fail: p.fail, ok: p.ok,
          z: p.z, leak: p.leak,
          // Static SVG drops out-of-grid words; here they render pinned to the
          // grid edge so nothing vanishes in the interactive view.
          fx: Math.max(0.3, Math.min(10000, p.freq_ok)),
          fy: Math.max(0.3, Math.min(10000, p.freq_fail)),
          bias: p.z > 0.5 ? 'fail' : (p.z < -0.5 ? 'ok' : 'neutral')
        };
      });
      var biasKeys = ['fail', 'neutral', 'ok'];
      var filters = { fail: true, neutral: true, ok: true, leak: true };
      var query = '';
      var pinned = {};   // word -> pinned word record (label pinned near its dot)
      var currentTransform = d3.zoomIdentity;
      var HEIGHT = 600;

      function esc(s) {
        return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      }
      var fmtInt = d3.format(',');

      function dotRadius(p) { return Math.min(10, 2 + 2.3 * Math.log1p(p.fail + p.ok)); }

      function dotColor(p) {
        return p.bias === 'fail' ? '#e08580' : p.bias === 'ok' ? '#66c4a8' : '#b9c4d6';
      }

      function tooltipHtml(p) {
        return '<div class="sc-tip-word">' + esc(p.word) +
               (p.leak ? ' <span class="sc-tip-leak">prompt-leaked</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
               '<div>failed traces: <b>' + fmtInt(p.fail) + '</b> · correct: <b>' + fmtInt(p.ok) + '</b></div>' +
               '<div>log-odds z = <b>' + (p.z >= 0 ? '+' : '') + p.z.toFixed(2) + '</b></div>' +
               '<div>freq — failed <b>' + fmtInt(p.fy) + '/M</b> · correct <b>' + fmtInt(p.fx) + '/M</b></div>';
      }

      function showTooltip(event, p) {
        var rect = widgetEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        tooltipEl.innerHTML = tooltipHtml(p);
        tooltipEl.style.display = 'block';
        var x = event.clientX - rect.left;
        var y = event.clientY - rect.top;
        var tw = tooltipEl.offsetWidth || 240;
        var th = tooltipEl.offsetHeight || 90;
        var nx = x + 16 + tw > rect.width ? x - tw - 14 : x + 16;
        var ny = y + 16 + th > rect.height ? Math.max(4, y - th - 10) : y + 16;
        tooltipEl.style.left = Math.max(4, nx) + 'px';
        tooltipEl.style.top = ny + 'px';
      }

      function hideTooltip() { tooltipEl.style.display = 'none'; }

      function updateStatus() {
        var visible = 0;
        points.forEach(function (p) {
          if (filters[p.bias] && (filters.leak || !p.leak)) visible++;
        });
        statusEl.textContent = fmtInt(points.length) + ' words · ' + fmtInt(visible) +
                               ' visible · drag to pan · scroll to zoom';
      }

      function build() {
        var width = Math.max(canvasEl.clientWidth || 900, 320);
        var margin = { top: 44, right: 18, bottom: 52, left: 66 };
        var innerW = width - margin.left - margin.right;
        var innerH = HEIGHT - margin.top - margin.bottom;

        var svg = d3.select(canvasEl).selectAll('svg').data([null])
          .join('svg')
          .attr('width', width)
          .attr('height', HEIGHT)
          .attr('role', 'img')
          .attr('aria-label', 'Scattertext-style frequency scatter of reasoning-trace words');
        svg.selectAll('*').remove();

        var x = d3.scaleLog().domain([0.3, 10000]).range([0, innerW]);
        var y = d3.scaleLog().domain([0.3, 10000]).range([innerH, 0]);
        var tickFmt = function (v) { return v >= 1 ? d3.format('~s')(v) : String(v); };

        var plot = svg.append('g')
          .attr('transform', 'translate(' + margin.left + ',' + margin.top + ')');

        // Grid + axes (fixed, not zoomed)
        var gGridX = plot.append('g').attr('class', 'sc-grid-x');
        var gGridY = plot.append('g').attr('class', 'sc-grid-y');
        var gAxisX = plot.append('g').attr('class', 'sc-axis-x');
        var gAxisY = plot.append('g').attr('class', 'sc-axis-y');
        var xAxis = d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(6, '~s').tickFormat(tickFmt)
          .tickSize(0).tickPadding(8);
        var yAxis = d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(6, '~s').tickFormat(tickFmt)
          .tickSize(0).tickPadding(8);

        // Dashed reference diagonal (fixed)
        plot.append('line')
          .attr('x1', x(0.3)).attr('y1', y(0.3))
          .attr('x2', x(10000)).attr('y2', y(10000))
          .attr('stroke', '#98a2b3').attr('stroke-width', 1)
          .attr('stroke-dasharray', '6 5').attr('opacity', 0.7);

        // Corner hints (fixed)
        plot.append('text')
          .attr('x', 10).attr('y', 18)
          .attr('font-size', 12).attr('font-style', 'italic')
          .attr('fill', '#8a94a6')
          .text('top-left = failure hallmarks');
        plot.append('text')
          .attr('x', innerW - 10).attr('y', innerH - 12)
          .attr('text-anchor', 'end')
          .attr('font-size', 12).attr('font-style', 'italic')
          .attr('fill', '#8a94a6')
          .text('bottom-right = success drivers');

        // Axis labels
        plot.append('text')
          .attr('x', innerW / 2).attr('y', innerH + 38)
          .attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('font-size', 13)
          .attr('fill', '#1b2a4a')
          .text('Frequency per million tokens — CORRECT traces');
        plot.append('text')
          .attr('transform', 'translate(-46,' + (innerH / 2) + ') rotate(-90)')
          .attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('font-size', 13)
          .attr('fill', '#1b2a4a')
          .text('Frequency per million tokens — FAILED traces');

        // Zoomed content group
        var gView = plot.append('g');

        function zoomed(event) {
          currentTransform = event.transform;
          gView.attr('transform', currentTransform);
          var zx = currentTransform.rescaleX(x);
          var zy = currentTransform.rescaleY(y);
          gAxisX.call(xAxis.scale(zx));
          gAxisY.call(yAxis.scale(zy));
          gGridX.call(d3.axisBottom(zx).ticks(6, '~s').tickSize(-innerH).tickFormat(''));
          gGridY.call(d3.axisLeft(zy).ticks(6, '~s').tickSize(-innerW).tickFormat(''));
          gGridX.selectAll('line').attr('stroke', '#e8ecf3');
          gGridY.selectAll('line').attr('stroke', '#e8ecf3');
          gGridX.selectAll('path').attr('stroke', 'none');
          gGridY.selectAll('path').attr('stroke', 'none');
        }

        var zoom = d3.zoom()
          .scaleExtent([1, 40])
          .extent([[0, 0], [innerW, innerH]])
          .translateExtent([[0, 0], [innerW, innerH]])
          .clickDistance(4)
          .on('zoom', zoomed);

        // Plot background (inside zoom space): click clears pins
        gView.append('rect')
          .attr('width', innerW).attr('height', innerH)
          .attr('fill', 'none').attr('pointer-events', 'all')
          .on('click', function (event) {
            if (event.detail > 1) return;
            clearPins();
          });

        // Dots: circles (plain) + diamonds (prompt-leaked)
        var gDots = gView.append('g');
        var circle = gDots.selectAll('circle.dot').data(points).join('circle');
        circle.attr('class', function (p) { return 'dot bias-' + p.bias + (p.leak ? ' leak' : ''); })
          .attr('cx', function (p) { return x(p.fx); })
          .attr('cy', function (p) { return y(p.fy); })
          .attr('r', dotRadius)
          .attr('fill', dotColor)
          .attr('opacity', 0.62)
          .attr('stroke', 'none')
          .on('mouseenter', function (event, p) { showTooltip(event, p); })
          .on('mousemove', function (event, p) { showTooltip(event, p); })
          .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip)
          .on('click', function (event, p) {
            if (event.detail > 1) return;
            togglePin(p);
          });

        var diamondPath = d3.symbol().type(d3.symbolDiamond);
        var gDiamonds = gView.append('g');
        var leaked = points.filter(function (p) { return p.leak; });
        var diamond = gDiamonds.selectAll('path.dot').data(leaked).join('path');
        diamond.attr('class', function (p) { return 'dot bias-' + p.bias + ' leak'; })
          .attr('transform', function (p) { return 'translate(' + x(p.fx) + ',' + y(p.fy) + ')'; })
          .attr('d', function (p) { return diamondPath.size(2 * dotRadius(p) * dotRadius(p))(); })
          .attr('fill', dotColor)
          .attr('stroke', '#c9a227').attr('stroke-width', 1.2)
          .attr('opacity', 0.75)
          .on('mouseenter', function (event, p) { showTooltip(event, p); })
          .on('mousemove', function (event, p) { showTooltip(event, p); })
          .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip)
          .on('click', function (event, p) {
            if (event.detail > 1) return;
            togglePin(p);
          });

        // Pinned labels live inside zoom space so they follow their dots
        var gPins = gView.append('g').attr('class', 'sc-pins');

        function renderPins() {
          gPins.selectAll('*').remove();
          Object.keys(pinned).forEach(function (word) {
            var p = pinned[word];
            var px = x(p.fx), py = y(p.fy);
            var lx = Math.min(px + 12, innerW - 10);
            var ly = Math.max(py - 12, 12);
            gPins.append('line')
              .attr('x1', px).attr('y1', py).attr('x2', lx).attr('y2', ly)
              .attr('stroke', '#1b2a4a').attr('stroke-width', 0.9).attr('opacity', 0.5);
            var label = gPins.append('g').attr('transform', 'translate(' + lx + ',' + ly + ')');
            var text = label.append('text')
              .attr('x', 2).attr('y', 4)
              .attr('font-size', 12).attr('font-weight', 'bold')
              .attr('fill', '#1b2a4a')
              .text(word);
            var tw = text.node().getComputedTextLength();
            label.insert('rect', 'text')
              .attr('x', -3).attr('y', -10)
              .attr('width', tw + 8).attr('height', 17)
              .attr('rx', 4)
              .attr('fill', '#ffffff').attr('stroke', '#c9d2e0')
              .attr('stroke-width', 0.7).attr('opacity', 0.92);
            label.raise();
          });
        }

        function clearPins() {
          pinned = {};
          renderPins();
          updateStatus();
        }

        function togglePin(p) {
          if (pinned[p.word]) delete pinned[p.word];
          else pinned[p.word] = p;
          renderPins();
          updateStatus();
        }

        function applyFilters() {
          gDots.selectAll('circle.dot').each(function (p) {
            var show = filters[p.bias] && (filters.leak || !p.leak);
            this.style.display = show ? null : 'none';
          });
          gDiamonds.selectAll('path.dot').each(function (p) {
            var show = filters[p.bias] && filters.leak;
            this.style.display = show ? null : 'none';
          });
          updateStatus();
        }

        function applySearch() {
          var q = query.toLowerCase();
          gDots.selectAll('circle.dot').each(function (p) {
            var m = q && p.word.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
            d3.select(this)
              .attr('opacity', q && !m ? 0.04 : 0.62)
              .attr('stroke', m ? '#c9a227' : 'none')
              .attr('stroke-width', m ? 1.4 : 0)
              .attr('r', m ? dotRadius(p) + 1.5 : dotRadius(p));
          });
          gDiamonds.selectAll('path.dot').each(function (p) {
            var m = q && p.word.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
            d3.select(this).attr('opacity', q && !m ? 0.04 : 0.75);
          });
          if (q) {
            var n = points.filter(function (p) { return p.word.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }).length;
            countEl.textContent = n + (n === 1 ? ' match' : ' matches');
          } else {
            countEl.textContent = '';
          }
          updateStatus();
        }

        function jumpToWord(p) {
          pinned[p.word] = p;
          renderPins();
          var k = 4;
          var tx = innerW / 2 - k * x(p.fx);
          var ty = innerH / 2 - k * y(p.fy);
          svg.transition().duration(400)
            .call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity.translate(tx, ty).scale(k));
          updateStatus();
        }

        searchEl.oninput = function () {
          query = searchEl.value.trim();
          applySearch();
        };
        searchEl.onkeydown = function (event) {
          if (event.key === 'Enter') {
            var q = query.toLowerCase();
            var match = points.filter(function (p) { return p.word.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; })[0];
            if (match) jumpToWord(match);
          } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
            query = '';
            searchEl.value = '';
            applySearch();
          }
        };
        resetEl.onclick = function () {
          query = '';
          searchEl.value = '';
          pinned = {};
          filters = { fail: true, neutral: true, ok: true, leak: true };
          d3.selectAll('.scatter-widget .sc-chip').classed('off', false);
          applySearch();
          applyFilters();
          renderPins();
          svg.transition().duration(300).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity);
        };
        d3.selectAll('.scatter-widget .sc-chip').on('click', function (event) {
          var bias = this.getAttribute('data-bias');
          filters[bias] = !filters[bias];
          d3.select(this).classed('off', !filters[bias]);
          applyFilters();
        });

        svg.call(zoom).call(zoom.transform, currentTransform);
        applyFilters();
        renderPins();
      }

      function onResize() {
        build();
      }

      var resizeTimer = null;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
        resizeTimer = setTimeout(onResize, 200);
      });

      build();
      updateStatus();
    })
    .catch(function (err) {
      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'Could not load scatter data (' + err.message + ') — see static SVG below.';
    });
})();
</script>


<figcaption>The interactive scattertext-style scatter — hover for counts, search and click to pin word labels, toggle legend chips to filter bias, and drag/zoom the grid. A static rendering follows as a print/no-JS fallback.</figcaption>

![Scattertext-style scatter — static rendering](../charts/scattertext_style.svg)

Every word on a log-log grid of frequency-per-million-tokens in correct (x) vs failed (y) traces. The **top-left corner** isolates hallmark failure language; the **bottom-right corner** the words driving successful classification. Words near the diagonal are class-neutral (both the prompt template and document text are shared across both classes).
